translations.web: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
translations.bsb: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
translations.kjv: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
translations.asv: His work is honor and majesty; And his righteousness endureth for ever.
